10k.note: 10-K describes two commercial segments: CooperVision (soft contact lenses, including MiSight 1 day myopia control) and CooperSurgical (women's healthcare devices and fertility products including Paragard IUD). R&D is focused on existing-product innovation and 510(k)/PMA medical-device pathways. No active proprietary drug pipeline disclosed.

commercial_product.summary: Two operating units: CooperVision (specialty contact lenses) and CooperSurgical (medical devices, fertility and women's-health products).
key_franchises: CooperVision: Biofinity, clariti, MyDay and Avaira silicone hydrogel lenses; MiSight 1 day (FDA-approved myopia-control lens for children); Proclear and other specialty lenses

CooperSurgical: Paragard non-hormonal copper IUD; uterine manipulators; obstetrical devices; PARAGARD T 380A; fertility products including witness IVF systems, donor egg/sperm services and Embryoscope time-lapse incubators

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Cooper Companies is a commercial medical device manufacturer (contact lenses via CooperVision; women's-health devices and fertility products via CooperSurgical). It does not develop drugs; Paragard, although classified as a drug-device combination, is a long-marketed product. No active proprietary P1/P2/P3 clinical pipeline.
